title: Word templates

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Choose a document structure that matches its length so readers can navigate information predictably.
strategic_value: Separate form and report templates can make Helsinki publications consistent without forcing every document into one layout.
demonstration: Expanded webpage section: three text groups distinguish short forms, multi-page reports and accessibility responsibilities, each with relevant links.
practical_value: Use form templates for short documents and report templates when a cover and contents are needed.

content_islands.name: Forms and reports
content_islands.spec: The first two groups contrast structures and language/color options.

content_islands.name: Accessibility responsibility
content_islands.spec: Bold guidance and an onward link close the section.

reference_purposes.Application: The page distinguishes short forms without cover/contents from multi-page reports with both.
